$comment: [S-9919] The sign-in members' panels: the device code and the pasted token. English first; translated in a follow-up (Q8).
signIn.noLoopbackPort: None of the ports this sign-in may come back to is free. Close what uses them and start again.
signIn.deviceExplain: Open {provider}'s page and enter this code there. This page carries on by itself once you allow Themia.
signIn.waitingCode: Waiting for the code to be entered
signIn.pasteExplain: Create a token on {provider}'s page, then paste it here. Themia keeps it sealed on this PC and never shows it again.
signIn.tokenShape: That does not look like a {provider} token.
signIn.grantPageDesc: {provider} lets this account read only what you choose there.
signIn.useBrowser: Sign in in the browser instead
signIn.useCode: Sign in with a code instead
